holdout_rule: 20% of SYR4 systems by stable blake2b hash modulo 5
icr_factorial_rule: same EVENT_ID paired nonnegative HAA5/HAA9; M0 uniform exact one-period enumeration; M1 complete finite paired grid; condition on HAA9/M1 >60
icr_full_window_rule: numeric support in each SAMP_QTR 1 through 6
icr_minus999_rule: below MRL analytical sentinel; never a numeric concentration; excluded from numeric support

icr_minus999_semantics.TUXDBP_HAA5_rule_DBP011000071: reported total is -999 when all five HAA5 components are below MRL
icr_minus999_semantics.TUXDBP_HAA9_rule_DBP011000131: reported total is -999 when all nine HAA9 components are below MRL
icr_minus999_semantics.TUXDBP_components: -999 denotes a below-MRL component; zero is used only inside the documented total calculation
icr_minus999_semantics.TUXWQP_special_average_rules: for TOC, TOX, and UV-254, -999 is used under the guide's initial/duplicate MRL-substitution averaging convention when the average equals the MRL
icr_minus999_semantics.analysis_handling: never treated as -999 or silently as zero; excluded from numeric summaries and threshold-support denominators unless a documented total is recomputed for identity QA
icr_minus999_semantics.general_rule_GR012000140: -999 is entered for an analytical result below the minimum reporting level

syr4_censoring_rule: non-detect interval [0, positive reported DL]; unknown upper bound if DL missing/zero/negative/unrecognized unit
syr4_duplicate_rule: collapse only identical analysis-critical signatures; exclude conflicting keys
syr4_primary_additional_rule: same HAA5 and TTHM sample collection date
